task_title: Fix boardctl completion provenance gate on real boards
task_criteria: Real-repo boards must reject nonexistent completion commit hashes and evidence run ids; preserve fixture exemptions; focused regression tests and go test ./... pass.

items.criterion: Real-repo boards must reject nonexistent completion commit hashes and evidence run ids; preserve fixture exemptions; focused regression tests and go test ./... pass.
items.detail: Real-repo probe on a fresh git repo (/tmp/probe-real-repo with .gitreins/history/2026-11-01/real-run-1): (A) phantom commit 40 zeros + phantom run => rc=1, 'boardctl: completion REFUSED: --commit-hash "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" is not a resolvable commit: fatal: Needed a single revision'; (B) phantom run only => rc=1, 'completion REFUSED: --evidence-run-id "deadbeef" is not an existing directory under .gitreins/history/'; (C) real HEAD + real-run-1 => rc=0 and row written with commit_hash + detail.evidence[run_id]. Fixture exemptions preserved: (D) tmp fixture with no git => rc=0; (E) testdata/board inside a real repo => rc=0. Refusal writes nothing: md5 of tasks.jsonl/events.jsonl identical before and after (5ce26086e6f1f6c4db2fbacfda0e8934 / 39a3241b02a76a87c25c2b341ca7733c). Root cause fixed at internal/board/evidence_gate.go:136-155 (isTestEnvironment now uses `git -C dir rev-parse --show-toplevel` instead of stat'ing <boarddir>/.git, which no real layout has). Tests: `go test ./internal/board/ -run 'TestBoardGuard003|TestIsTestEnvironment' -count=1 -v` => PASS, 'ok github.com/coding-hermes/boardctl/internal/board 0.045s' (all 6 tests incl. TestBoardGuard003RealRepoRejectsUnprovenProvenance and TestIsTestEnvironmentUsesRepositoryRoot subtests); `go test ./... -count=1` => every package 'ok' (cmd/boardctl 5.652s, internal/board 1.398s, ...), exit_code 0. go vet ./internal/board/ clean, gofmt -l reports nothing, LSP diagnostics empty.

findings.detection: new symbol `exec` used but no import added in this diff
findings.detail: isTestEnvironment now calls exec.Command, but the diff adds no `os/exec` import to evidence_gate.go (only the test file gained it), so the package will not compile unless the import already existed — the diff shows no such addition.

findings.detection: git invocation has no timeout and no error-path test for git-missing/git-failure
findings.detail: isTestEnvironment shells out to `git rev-parse` on every call and treats any error (including git not installed or a hung process) as 'test environment', silently disabling the provenance gate; the new tests only cover a real repo and tmp/testdata dirs, never the git-unavailable failure path.

findings.detection: test writes scratch dirs into repo-relative `.tick-cache` instead of t.TempDir()
findings.detail: Both new tests create fixtures under `<wd>/../../.tick-cache` rather than using t.TempDir(), diverging from the existing fixture helpers and leaving artifacts in the working tree if cleanup fails.

review.summary: The classifier rewrite shells out to git without adding the os/exec import to evidence_gate.go and without a failure-path test, plus tests use a non-standard scratch location.
